say:1:1041576901:1.text: Dear, I heard you run a restaurant too? And that you're quite the cook!
say:1:1041576901:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，听说你也是一家餐馆的老板？做的一手好菜？

say:2:1041576902:1.text: I am the creative director of a culinary brand. My latest venture is "Silken Snare" in Savannah.
say:2:1041576902:1.source_cn: 我是餐饮品牌的主理人，最近开的一家新店是赛凡纳的丝绒陷阱。

say:3:1041576903:1.text: "Creative director"? Is that one of those fancy new city terms?
say:3:1041576903:1.source_cn: 主理人是什么？最近流行的新说法吗？

say:4:1041576904:1.text: Haha, I've been in Cedartown for so long, I wanted to ask someone from outside how business is nowadays.
say:4:1041576904:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我在雪松镇待久了，想向你打听打听外面的生意好不好做。

say:5:1041576905:1.text: Who knows? Maybe one day I'll open a branch of the Frozen Paw right in the heart of Savannah!
say:5:1041576905:1.source_cn: 说不定，以后我也能在赛凡纳开家白熊温泉旅店的分店呢！

say:6:1041576906:1.text: Rent in the upper district is exorbitant. If you were to scout a location for your establishment, the lower district would be more appropriate.
say:6:1041576906:1.source_cn: 上城区租金不菲，你的旅店若想选址的话，选下城区更为合适。

say:7:1041576907:1.text: Oh, I'm not worried about the details yet! Just tell me, what's popular to eat in Savannah these days?
say:7:1041576907:1.source_cn: 现在还没考虑那么多呢！你先跟我说说，赛凡纳最近都流行吃...

say:8:1041576908:1.text: Truffle and foie gras are standard, of course, but the nobility has recently developed a palate for flavors in their purest form.
say:8:1041576908:1.source_cn: 松露、鹅肝之类的自不必提，最近贵族们颇爱品味极致纯粹的口感。

say:9:1041576909:1.text: For instance... silverfish, caught from the deepest trenches and untouched by flame.
say:9:1041576909:1.source_cn: 比如……刚从深海捕捞上来、完全未经任何火焰破坏的冰海银鱼。

say:10:1041576910:1.text: We suspend the fish with threads of fine crystal in a temperature-controlled chamber. Then, using silver blades, we shave off paper-thin slices, preserving the raw, primal chill of the deep.
say:10:1041576910:1.source_cn: 我们会用极细的晶丝将其悬吊，在绝对低温的室内，用银刀片...

say:11:1041576911:1.text: What? Completely uncooked? And without seasoning?!
say:11:1041576911:1.source_cn: 什么？吃没有经过烹饪、连调料都不放的生鱼？

say:12:1041576912:1.text: Dura above! Do the nobles in Savannah have iron stomachs?
say:12:1041576912:1.source_cn: 我的老天爷！你们赛凡纳的贵族是不怕拉肚子吗？

say:13:1041576913:1.text: Heh... That is the only way to appreciate its true flavor. Crude, high-heat cooking destroys the delicate structure of the ingredient and strips away its finest notes.
say:13:1041576913:1.source_cn: 呵……这样才能品味纯粹的鲜美。任何粗暴的高温烹煮，只会...

say:14:1041576914:1.text: Goodness me! A fish isn't a meal until it's pan-fried golden on both sides, or simmered with mushrooms into a hearty stew!
say:14:1041576914:1.source_cn: 哎哟喂，要我说，鱼就得在热锅里煎得两面金黄，或者和蘑菇...

say:15:1041576915:1.text: One sip of that hot soup and your whole body warms right up!
say:15:1041576915:1.source_cn: 那一口热乎汤下肚，整个人都暖和过来了！

say:16:1041576916:1.text: Golden and crispy? That greasy char is an insult to the ingredient itself.
say:16:1041576916:1.source_cn: 煎得金黄？那种油腻和焦褐感，简直是对食材的亵渎。

say:17:1041576917:1.text: When guests come to my inn, they want a hearty meal and a lively atmosphere.
say:17:1041576917:1.source_cn: 客人来我这儿，就是为了吃个痛快、吃个热闹。

say:18:1041576918:1.text: If I served them a plate of raw fish and told them to "appreciate the texture", they'd riot!
say:18:1041576918:1.source_cn: 要是上盘生肉让他们去体会口感，我这旅店怕是要被砸了！

say:19:1041576919:1.text: As I suspected. Cedartown is a rural backwater place. It seems my expertise is wasted on you.
say:19:1041576919:1.source_cn: 所以说，雪松镇终究只是个乡下地方。我的经验，对你是没用了。

say:20:1041576920:1.text: And I've got no interest in serving cold food like that anyway!
say:20:1041576920:1.source_cn: 让我做那种冷冰冰的东西给客人吃，我才不乐意呢！

say:21:1041576921:1.text: I'll stick to my Paw Herring, served piping hot to fill a traveler's belly!
say:21:1041576921:1.source_cn: 我还是多做几道温泉香鲱，热乎乎地填饱客人的胃吧！
